mode: upstream-frontend + 极客班论坛 site build + local read-only snapshot adapter

modifiedUpstreamFiles.nuxt.config.ts: Inject public environment/version metadata from the root declarative domain contract; contentSource/siteName/loginMode come from shared/content-source.ts (GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=site: 极客班论坛 with its own categories and tags and no content directory, which is how the images are built; GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=demo: the upstream seed; unset: the snapshot when GEEK_FORUM_CONTENT_DIR is set, the seed otherwise; loginMode is site unless GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo on the demo seed); set app.baseURL from GEEK_FORUM_BASE_PATH so the static build can be served under the portal domain /forum path; prerender /llms.txt and /t/<id>.md for every seed topic (only /llms.txt for 极客班论坛, which has no topics yet; answered by server/middleware/forum-markdown.ts) so the static build ships them as files, and publish that topic list as runtime public markdownTopicIds; define the build-time constant import.meta.env.GEEK_FORUM_SITE so a site build leaves the demo seed out of the browser bundle; no static head title. Local is not preview, and metadata does not authorize deployment. Dev only: nitro.devProxy forwards /auth and /api/public/org to the local core server (127.0.0.1:3000) with Origin set to the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173, so the forum dev server can read the site-wide session, sign out through the core Origin check and read the 称号/部门 display data for TitleBadge; not part of the static build (online the forum shares the core origin).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/about.vue: Show the owner's preview/production domains and environment/version card (DeploymentInfo: preview is released by a vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag on a stage commit and shows X.Y.Z-rc.N@<sha12>; production by vX.Y.Z on the same commit and shows X.Y.Z; pushing a branch releases nothing); describe 极客班论坛 in a site build (posting, replies and the old posts are not connected yet; one line credits the open-source Tuff Forum, talex-touch/tuff-forum, MIT) without the stats and staff cards, which would be empty; describe the 极客班 read-only snapshot when it is the content source, upstream demo text otherwise. The heading spaces the site name like Chinese text does (关于 Tuff Forum, 关于极客班论坛; shared/content-source.ts siteNameInText).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/categories.vue: Category rows show both cues: category.icon as the TxCardItem icon-class avatar and upstream's TxBadge colour dot in front of the name (title slot), so the upstream 8-dot assertion holds; rows carry role=link; recent-topic TxCellLink hrefs carry app.baseURL. With no topics (a 极客班论坛 build) the desktop 最新 card shows a small 还没有话题 empty state, and a category row without recent topics drops the empty link list under it.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/c/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the category name is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/tag/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the tag is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/users.vue: The member TxCellLink href carries app.baseURL (useAppLink); the 角色 cell shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the user has a title (the forum role badge otherwise), sorts by titleRank (fixed in code: 提督 0 … no title 9) then role rank, and is widened to fit 「社区部 · 队长」. The header text stays 角色 because the upstream directory check asserts it. With no users at all (a 极客班论坛 build) the directory shows 还没有用户 / 成员列表还没接入。 instead of the filter-miss message.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/layouts/default.vue: Wrap the page area in LocalSnapshotGate; the LoginModal comment describes both login modes; no business rewrite.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/app.vue: Site name from the content source in the title template; hide the /new command under the site-wide login (posting is not open yet); in a site build the /about command reads 论坛简介, because that page has no staff card.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/error.vue: Site name from the content source in the error page title template.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/plugins/persist.client.ts: Skip localStorage hydration and writes entirely in snapshot mode so the real archive never lands in the demo storage, in a 极客班论坛 site build so demo posts stored in this browser can never pass as forum content, and under the site-wide login so a stored mock identity can never pass as signed in.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumHeader.vue: Site name from content source; the official 极客班 logo (/logo.png, decorative, accessible name = visible site name) replaces TxTuffLogoStroke in front of it (owner 2026-09-25, #62: the stroke logo read as a blurry dot and the logo belongs in the header, not a sidebar card). The demo user menu starts with a disabled 「@<handle> · <role>」 row, because the sidebar no longer shows the signed-in account. Under the site-wide login the forum has no login of its own: the header reads /auth/me; signed in shows the GitHub avatar with 控制台 / 退出; signed out shows a single 用 GitHub 登录 button (登录 on narrow screens, same accessible name) that goes to /auth/github with return_to back to the current forum page including query and hash; in dev the login and 控制台 go through the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173. Login mode is separate from the content source (runtime public loginMode): the site-wide GitHub login is the default for every build, including the deployed 极客班论坛 (site) images; only scripts/forum.mjs sets GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo for the upstream CDP suites and the local sample preview, which keep the upstream mock login unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumSidebar.vue: No workspace card and no footer account card (owner 2026-09-25, #62): TxSidebarNav gets no workspace prop, so the filter field is the first row; the 极客班 logo and site name live in ForumHeader, the account only in its avatar menu. Fine-tuned font sizes; category rows show the category icon with upstream's TxBadge colour dot on its corner (both cues, upstream dot assertion intact). The footer only exists outside the site-wide login and holds 重置示例数据 alone (the demo 登录 button is in the header); under the site-wide login nothing is kept in this browser, so there is no footer.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/composables/useForumNav.ts: Pass category.icon to sidebar nav items; the sidebar pairs that icon with upstream's dotColors colour dot.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/LoginModal.vue: The mock member picker renders only in the demo login mode. modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/PostCard.vue: Wrap Markdown view in an overflow container for mobile table/code scrolling; the copied permalink and the author TxCellLink href carry app.baseURL (useAppLink); the author row shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the author has a title, the upstream role badge otherwise.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/TopicControls.vue: Guest prompt wording under the site-wide login (replies and reactions not open yet, no 登录 button); the share link carries app.baseURL (useAppLink).

modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/types.ts: Optional User.avatarUrl for snapshot avatars (the seed never sets it) and optional User.title (极客班 称号, see app/data/titles.ts); role semantics unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.uno.config.ts: Safelist the category icons that arrive as snapshot/curation data (the scanner cannot see them) and re-run the config when content/curation.json changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/lib/cdp.mjs: Configurable Chromium executable, unique temporary profiles, own-process-group cleanup instead of broad pkill. Original assertions remain intact.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/u/[username]/index.vue: Profile banner shows the 极客班 TitleBadge (size md) beside the name, in addition to the unchanged forum-role badge.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed-content.ts: UserSeed.title and the demo 极客班 titles: talex 舰长, mika 社区部 · 队长, yuki 技术部 · 队长, kai 技术部 · 舰员, lin 领航员, six plain members; bruce none. Three seed bodies say the same thing without the → arrow character (the owner bans decorative arrows); no topic, title, count or reply changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed.ts: buildUsers copies the optional seed title onto the user (a fresh object per user); consumes no PRNG draws, so every other seeded value is unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/permissions.ts: Adds hasForumCapability(user, capability): admin/moderator by role hold every forum capability as before, anyone else holds what their 极客班 title carries (titleForumCapabilities: the forum part of the server's default title packs (ROLE_BASE: 提督 and 舰长 everything) plus the default department packs). These packs stay local defaults: the server publishes no permission packs to the forum (GET /api/public/org carries display data only), so a pack the 提督 edits in the console does not reach the forum until its backend exists (#57). isStaff = forum.post.moderate (edit/delete others' posts, reply in closed topics); pinTopic reads forum.topic.pin and closeTopic reads forum.topic.close. Demo permissions only, not an authorization boundary; every other ForumAction rule is unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/t/[id].vue: The 话题管理 menu shows when the viewer may pin or close (can('pinTopic') / can('closeTopic')) instead of isStaff, and lists only the items they may use, so a title that carries forum.topic.pin alone (项目部 head) sees 置顶话题 without 关闭话题. Admins and moderators still get both items; the upstream staff pin check is unchanged. Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> to the topic head, only for topics that have a Markdown file (runtime public markdownTopicIds from nuxt.config.ts: the seed topics, none in a 极客班论坛 build; or every topic of the dev snapshot), read from the runtime config so a site build does not bundle the seed topics; the post stream is unchanged.
